name: studyforge
description: StudyForge modular monorepo: TypeScript frontend và Node.js backend.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@studyforge/frontend && npm run build --workspace=@studyforge/backend
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/unit/dictionary-parser.test.ts tests/unit/dictionary-client.test.ts tests/unit/dictionary-translation.test.ts tests/unit/knowledge-tree.test.ts tests/unit/postgres-resilience.test.ts tests/unit/v2-business.test.ts tests/unit/frontend-config.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@studyforge/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace=@studyforge/frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace=@studyforge/backend && tsc --project tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.qa: npm run quality:docker && npm run smoke
